intentComment: Story 082 - MAINNET StableStaker V1 -> V2 CUTOVER with Antimatter (script/CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet.s.sol). One resumable run: pause V1; deploy Antimatter (name Antimatter, symbol AM - hard-coded in its constructor) owned by 0xCad1..D0B6 and wire phUSD + PhusdStableMinter; deploy StableStakerV2 and PAUSE it before any addToken; per V1 token (read live off V1.getStakedTokens) addToken / setClient / idle-balance guard / setYieldStrategy / set-aside buffer copied from V1 / antimatterPerDay = V1 phusdPerSecond*86400*21/10; grant V2 Antimatter mint, V2 phUSD mint AND Antimatter phUSD mint (Antimatter.annihilate mints phUSD; without it autoAnnihilate - V2's only reward path while claimEnabled is false - reverts 'phUSD: caller is not authorized to mint', proven in preview); CrossVersionMigrator + setMigrator both sides; per token relinquish the story-060 principal surplus, initiateMigration, plan every live staker with the dust predicate (credit==0 rides a batch; credit>0 that cannot deposit into V2 is a named straggler allowed only under a 1-cent cap, else STOP AND REPORT), batch-migrate (25 per call, strict-progress guard), post-conditions (per-user loss <= 2 bps + 2 wei on the ERC4626 autopools, 2*30+1 bps on USDe; V2 totalStaked == sum of stakers; strategy principal >= V2 booked); finalize: buffer recipient -> V2 (the live USDe strategy predates the recipient and pays each client directly), revoke V1 phUSD mint, V1 pauser back to Pauser and V1 UNPAUSED (inert - every pool Migrating, mint revoked; a paused registered contract would make the global Pauser.pause() loop revert), V2 + Antimatter pauser -> Pauser and registered, V2 unpaused, claimEnabled stays false; Phase 8 wiring assertions incl. a two-sided phUSD minter-set delta (only the V1 bit may clear). Owner 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6, Ledger HD m/44'/60'/46'/0/0. Run :preview first, read it, then :broadcast.

variantComments.preview: Dry run against LIVE mainnet: impersonates OWNER, signs nothing, broadcasts nothing, NEVER writes the progress file (preview CREATE addresses are fork-local fiction). It READS server/deployments/progress.stable-staker-v2-cutover.1.json when present, so AFTER a completed broadcast every idempotent phase detects - from on-chain state - that it is done and skips, and the run becomes the post-broadcast verification: Phase 8 wiring assertions plus the preview-only smoke tests against the live contracts. Smoke tests (prank only): the user-mandated Antimatter mint-revocation proof (throwaway minter approved -> mints -> revoked -> mint reverts; V2 revoked -> mint reverts -> re-approved), a 100-unit stake/withdraw on every V2 pool, and a 1000 DOLA stake + 10-minute warp + autoAnnihilate that must pay phUSD (a longer warp trips Tokemak's Chainlink staleness inside autoDOLA, not our wiring).
variantComments.broadcast: LIVE BROADCAST. Backs up mainnet-addresses.ts, runs the cutover on the Ledger, then the MANDATORY '&&' tail: patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js FILLS the StableStakerV2 and Antimatter zero placeholders from the progress file (refuses unless deploymentStatus is completed; same-address is success so a resume leg is idempotent; key-set drift guard exit 3) and finally chains to :preview, which reads the progress file and re-runs every assertion and smoke test against the live deployment. '&&' not ';' - patching after a failed forge run would write addresses that may not exist. --legacy --with-gas-price 0.3gwei and --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 are the story-071/073 lessons carried from promotion-ready (EIP-1559 maxFee dips below base fee in a long --slow Ledger session; per-block accrual makes depositFor cost more than the single-timestamp estimate); base fee was ~0.16 gwei at planning - re-check before signing. ~47 transactions (rehearsed end to end on an anvil mainnet fork). RESUME: the progress file is written in forge's LOCAL pass before sending, so after a crash it can name a contract that never landed - trim it to on-chain-confirmed deployments (run-latest.json receipts + cast nonce), keep the baselines block verbatim, run :preview, then re-run this key; every step is state-gated and the migration re-plans from live V1 state. The script aborts on any recorded address with no code.

preview.notes: Live-mainnet rpc (not --fork-url); vm.startPrank(OWNER); progress file READ if present, never written; runs _previewSmokeTests (deal/warp/prank) after Phase 8.

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && forge script script/CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet.s.sol:CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price 0.3gwei --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js && npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:preview
broadcast.notes: PREVIEW_MODE unset => vm.startBroadcast(); progress file written in forge LOCAL pass (in_progress after each CREATE, completed after Phase 8). '&&' chain: backup -> forge -> patch -> npm run :preview (post-broadcast verification).

post.note: chains the preview variant as post-broadcast verification
